seo.title: Tutela actions | Orión Lex
seo.description: We prepare and file tutela actions to protect your fundamental rights: health, petition, due process and minimum subsistence. Online service throughout Colombia.

cta.label: Request advice
cta.message: Hello, I saw the Orión Lex website and I need help with a tutela action.

hero.lead: Do you believe one of your fundamental rights is being violated?
paragraphs: The tutela action is a mechanism to ask a judge for the immediate protection of fundamental rights such as health, petition, due process or minimum subsistence, when there is no other effective way to defend them.
hero.emphasis: At ORIÓN LEX we review your case and, if applicable, prepare and file the tutela with the necessary evidence.

cases.title: When can it help you?
items: You are denied treatments, medicines or medical appointments.
A petition you filed has not been answered.
Due process was not respected in a proceeding.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: We analyze whether the tutela is the right mechanism for your case.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.description: We gather the documents and evidence, and draft the action.

steps.title: Filing
steps.description: We file the tutela with the competent judge.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.description: We follow the process and verify that the judge's orders are complied with.

items.question: How long does the judge take to decide?
items.answer: The judge must decide within 10 business days after the tutela is filed (Decree 2591 of 1991).

items.question: Do I need a lawyer to file a tutela?
items.answer: It is not mandatory. Having advice helps you clearly present the facts, the rights violated and the evidence.

items.question: What happens if the ruling is not complied with?
items.answer: A contempt proceeding (incidente de desacato) can be started to demand compliance with the judge's orders.

closing.title: Tell us your situation
closing.text: Write to us on WhatsApp and we will review whether a tutela is the right path for your case.
closing.coverage: We work online throughout Colombia and with people living abroad who need to resolve legal matters in the country.
